criteria.reason: The exposed screen states whole-order rejection without debit, preflight availability to avoid rollback, and implementation and testing of rejection followed by later-order success. The independent reader correctly recovers all three from the visible text.

evidence.quote: Outcome: reject an entire order when any item lacks stock; preserve all counts and continue later orders. Decision: check every requested item before debit; this avoids partially applied rejected orders and needs no rollback machinery. Next: implement and test a rejected a/b order followed by a valid order, retaining JSON API compatibility.
